🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF, as provided. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, mixed/rotation; confirmation comes from VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) ABOVE TREND and the falling stocks-versus-bonds ratio (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND. Credit also weakens: HYG/LQD (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%) BELOW TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) ABOVE TREND. Credit stress rising as HYG/LQD (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%) falls BELOW TREND; defensive relative strength is evident in the cyclical-versus-defensive ratio (1W: -0.60% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is edging higher: dollar-strength metric (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND, ↑ rising. Yield curve metric (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND, → flat; TLT (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND as duration gains against equities.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive resilience and selective rotation: XLP (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND and XLRE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND while XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) is BELOW TREND. Style: Value over Growth, with defensives also firm.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are BELOW TREND: SPY (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%); international performance is mixed, with VGK (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +2.20%) in CORRECTION and EEM (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -10.24%) BELOW TREND. China is firmer: FXI (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +4.48%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is weak: ARKK (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -13.86%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -7.31%) BELOW TREND. Small caps are also BELOW TREND: IWM (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Gold is recovering: GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%) in RECOVERY, while copper remains weak: CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND. Copper/gold ratio (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND signals weaker cyclical momentum.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is under pressure: XLE (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -2.23%) BELOW TREND. Natural gas is a short-term bounce, not a trend reversal: UNG (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -13.51%) in RECOVERY.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED weakness: SPY (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%) and XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) are BELOW TREND, alongside rising fear in VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: TLT (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND versus falling equities; defensive breadth tempers the risk-off signal.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive resilience and selective value exposure; XLP (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%) and XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) are ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to technology weakness in XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) BELOW TREND; bonds show relative support in TLT (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If defensive breadth holds, monitor XLP (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND and XLRE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If technology weakness persists, reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If haven demand continues, monitor GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%) in RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If cyclical momentum remains soft, monitor CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor VXX at 21.95 (fear), HYG/LQD at 0.7388 (credit), stocks-versus-bonds at 8.9757, and copper/gold at 0.1011.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, indicating mixed/rotation rather than broad weakness. Defensive areas and financials show relative resilience, while value is outperforming growth. Monitor rising fear and credit stress alongside persistent technology weakness.
